summary.unread_list: pons_unread.json: every Pons-hook pool in the engines' poolfee.tsv (6,196) minus blood-poolfee pons_terms.json (3,149) = 3,047

validation.no_hook_event: 2 sells sent BY the pad's fee-sweep operator TO the hook (fee-exempt own swaps, as v4-real-cost 4c found), not trader swaps
validation.trader_side: single-hop buys where the take is on the token leg: trader received exactly (1 - read take) of the pool output in 19 of 20; the 20th paid 0.25 % more to its own router (0x8876...)
validation.router_skims_on_sells: 2 of 21 single-hop sells paid 1.05 % / 0.25 % extra tokens to a third-party router; not the pool, not the hook

summary.control: 5 pools with known terms re-read in the first batch: 5/5 identical decode
summary.rpc: robinhood-rpc.publicnode.com only, IPv4, UA wick-research/1.0, >= 0.77 s apart (+3 s between batches), every call in rpc_log.ndjson
summary.method:
build_output.py - pons_fee_terms.json in the shape of realism-2026-09-27/pool_fees.json ({summary, pools: pid -> {status, lp, hook,
take_per_side, ...}}) so it can be merged. Every Pons pool: the 3,047 read here, the 3,149 read earlier (v4-real-cost + blood-realcost,
copied from blood-poolfee pons_terms.json), and an ADDENDUM of 2,713 Pons pools that trade on the tape but are not in poolfee.tsv.
Take per side = (hookFeeBps + creatorTaxBps)/1e4, charged by the hook on the swap's unspecified leg, the SAME on buys and sells
(PonsV2MemeHook afterSwap; terms frozen at registerPool). LP fee is 0 on every Pons pool (fee 0 in the key; 79/79 receipts).
